brief: Title sting for Light Falls in the site's late-night broadcast look. A colour-bar test card ('Please stand by') flips through six channels of the photographer's own frames, each cut a three-frame burst of seeded static, each frame carrying its real channel number and collection title in Geist Pixel chips. The last channel is the Andromeda Galaxy; then the screen goes ultramarine for the pixel aperture, the Jacquard 24 title and the credit. Photographs are shown unaltered: no grading, no filters, only scale; scanlines and vignette sit over the whole screen like the site's CRT.
frames_source: src/data/curation.json ids, resolved to public/photos/<file>-1920.avif by build.mjs
